brief: Trial NCT03068754 (Mallinckrodt). Why did it stop, what category is the stated reason, and were results posted on time?

findings.claim: Trial NCT03068754 was terminated because "As recommended by the study's independent Data and Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB)"
findings.notes: Confirmed in snapshot and live ClinicalTrials.gov record.

findings.claim: The stated reason category for NCT03068754 is safety.
Results for NCT03068754 were posted on time with 0 days late (primary completion date 2019-11-25, results due date 2020-11-24, results first post date 2020-09-03).
findings.notes: Results were posted before the due date.

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.sponsor, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.days_late FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT03068754'

tool_calls.name: get_trial_live
tool_calls.result: NCT03068754: TERMINATED, why_stopped="As recommended by the study's independent Data and Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB"
